description: Age from start to end as calendar years, months, and days. end defaults to today (UTC). A birthday on 29 February does not become a whole year on 28 February of a common year: 2020-02-29 to 2021-02-28 is 0 years, 11 months, and 30 days. 2020-02-29 to 2024-02-29 is 4 years. The parts are negative when end is before start. total_days is the signed number of calendar days from start to end. The result is years, months, days, and total_days. The dates are not repeated.

end.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

start.description: Start date, such as a birthdate, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: age_duration

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

title: Age in years, months, and days
